title: In-Model Context Compression with Agentic Soft Tokens for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.41291v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents play an important role in solving complex and sustained tasks, with ever-growing interaction contexts. However, these accumulated contexts will raise substantial computational cost and obscure key decision-relevant evidence. Existing methods typically train external compressors or context-management agents to rewrite context as shorter hard-token sequences, but such external selection may not align with the LLM's evolving representation and is necessarily lossy. In this paper, we introduce Agentic Soft-Token Compression (ASTC), a training-free compression method using soft tokens within LLM agent for long-horizon tasks. Specifically, ASTC uses the model's native recurrent dynamics to determine the already absorbed information, leveraging the commonly-used hybrid Gated Delta Network (GDN)-attention. translated_title: 基于智能体软令牌的模型内上下文压缩，面向长时程LLM智能体
translated_abstract: 长时程LLM智能体在解决复杂且持续的任务中扮演着重要角色，其交互上下文会不断增长。然而，这些累积的上下文会带来巨大的计算成本，并掩盖关键的决策相关证据。现有方法通常训练外部压缩器或上下文管理智能体，将上下文重写为较短的硬令牌序列，但这种外部选择可能与LLM不断演化的内部表示不一致，且必然是有损的。在本文中，我们提出了智能体软令牌压缩，这是一种免训练的压缩方法，在LLM智能体内部使用软令牌来处理长时程任务。具体而言，ASTC借助常用的混合门控Delta网络-注意力机制，利用模型原生的循环动态来确定已被吸收的信息，然后将这些信息作为智能体软令牌向前传递，同时将精确值保留为硬令牌。结果……
tldr: 提出免训练的智能体软令牌压缩方法（ASTC），利用混合GDN-注意力的原生循环动态将已吸收信息压缩为模型内软令牌，在降低长时程LLM智能体计算成本的同时保留关键决策信息。
en_tdlr: Proposes ASTC, a training-free in-model context compression method that leverages the native recurrent dynamics of hybrid GDN-attention to carry absorbed information forward as agentic soft tokens, reducing computational cost for long-horizon LLM agents while preserving decision-relevant evidence.
